IC.IC1: Patient has provided signed informed consent
IC.IC2: Patient is aged greater than or equal to 40 and less than or equal to 89 years of age

IC3.IC3.2: between 90g and 200g, as determined by MRI

IC.IC4: Patient has experienced lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS) for at least 6 months prior to study enrollment
IC.IC5: Patient has an IPSS score of at least 13 at baseline

IC6.IC6.1: Patient is either: refractory to medical treatment

IC7.IC7.2: OR is contraindicated for surgical treatment

IC8.IC8.1: Patient meets ONE of the following criteria: baseline PSA
IC8.IC8.2: < 4.0ng/mL (no prostate biopsy required) OR baseline PSA >/= 4 ng/mL AND a negative prostate biopsy (minimum 12 core biopsy) within the prior 12 months
